name: Fort McMurray to Kitimat Demo (synthetic)
description: Demonstration project for exploring FlowGuard: a crude oil export line from Fort McMurray, Alberta to the port of Kitimat, British Columbia. Only the two end points are real places. All constraint layers and terrain shown between them are synthetic and do not describe the real landscape (for example, the Rocky and Coast Mountains are not represented). This is not a real or proposed pipeline. Any real project in this region would require engagement with affected First Nations, Métis and other communities, which this demo does not represent.

assumptions.assumption: End points are the communities of Fort McMurray, AB and Kitimat, BC (approximate town coordinates, not a terminal site)
All GIS constraint layers are synthetic until real data is loaded
Terrain (elevation) is synthetic; mountain ranges on the real corridor are not represented
Unit construction costs use placeholder rates
Design capacity 83,000 m³/day (about 525,000 bbl/day), 914 mm (36 in) line
Budget of CAD 5.5 billion is illustrative only
